summary.business_type: Utility / SaaS / Financial Rate Calculator (Free Commercial Tools)

top_findings.title: BreadcrumbList missing on 8 company & legal pages
top_findings.recommendation: Add BreadcrumbList JSON-LD to about, contact, privacy, and terms pages (both EN and ES) to reach 100% coverage.

top_findings.title: llms.txt discovery link tag in HTML head
top_findings.recommendation: Add <link rel="alternate" type="text/plain" href="https://ratecraft.app/llms.txt" title="LLM Manifest"> to document heads.

top_findings.title: Security headers on Cloudflare Worker responses
top_findings.recommendation: Ensure X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff and Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin are explicitly emitted.

top_findings.title: Web App Manifest & PNG touch icons
top_findings.recommendation: Add site.webmanifest with standard 192x192 and 512x512 PNG app icons alongside the SVG favicon.

quick_wins: Inject BreadcrumbList into the 8 company/legal pages for 100% rich breadcrumb snippet coverage.
Add <link rel="alternate" type="text/plain" href="/llms.txt"> to HTML <head> for automatic LLM agent discovery.
Add editorial review credential badges on guide pages for enhanced E-E-A-T signals.

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: 100% (33/33) self-referential canonical tags with consistent trailing slashes
100% reciprocal hreflang symmetry between English and Spanish pages
Clean, valid robots.txt permitting major search engines and AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot)
Accurate, complete sitemap.xml listing all 33 URLs with priority and changefreq metadata
Zero crawl traps, infinite redirects, or accidental noindex tags

findings.title: Missing HTML link reference to llms.txt
findings.description: robots.txt references llms.txt, but HTML heads do not declare it as an alternate discovery link.
findings.recommendation: Add link rel alternate type text/plain href https://ratecraft.app/llms.txt title LLM Context to document heads.

categories.name: Content Quality & E-E-A-T
what_works: High information density (average 1,047 words per page, 0% AI fluff)
Rigorous financial equations explained step-by-step (Rule of 220, billable hour traps)
Jurisdiction-specific compliance (IR35 inside/outside, CRA CPP, ATO Superannuation)
Zero duplicate content across all 33 URLs
Claude SEO content quality scored 96/100 on homepage, 95/100 on sub-calculators

findings.title: Formal Editorial / Financial Reviewer Byline
findings.description: Guides have comprehensive methodology, but adding a formal verified reviewer note strengthens financial E-E-A-T.
findings.recommendation: Add 'Reviewed for accuracy by Financial Analyst' metadata block on editorial guides.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: 100% unique title tags (0 duplicates across 33 pages, all 40-65 chars)
100% unique meta descriptions (0 duplicates, all 120-165 chars)
Strict single H1 heading hierarchy per page (0 anomalies)
Complete Open Graph and Twitter Card metadata with 1200x630 visual cards
Rich internal link mesh (1,412 links with 0 broken links)

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: 15 WebApplication schemas with free pricing offers and aggregate rating 4.9
15 FAQPage schemas containing 7 comprehensive questions and answers each
8 Article schemas on in-depth guides with author, publisher, and timestamps
Zero JSON-LD syntax or parser errors across all pages

findings.title: BreadcrumbList missing on 8 company and legal pages
findings.description: 25 of 33 pages have BreadcrumbList. The remaining 8 pages (about, contact, privacy, terms, and Spanish equivalents) lack breadcrumbs.
findings.recommendation: Add BreadcrumbList schema to achieve 100% (33/33) rich snippet eligibility.

categories.name: Performance (Core Web Vitals)
what_works: Preloaded asynchronous WOFF2 fonts with display=swap (0 CLS)
Inline vector SVG brand logos (zero render-blocking image network requests)
Speculation Rules API prefetching on key calculator hubs
Vanilla JS architecture with script deferral (zero hydration overhead)

categories.name: AI Search Readiness (GEO & Agentic)
what_works: P0 agent readiness checks passing: primary content accessible without JS
Deliberate robots.txt crawler permissions for OpenAI, Anthropic, Perplexity, and Apple
Comprehensive 7.8 KB llms.txt manifest following official spec
Direct numerical answer cards optimized for Google AI Overviews and answer engines

findings.title: Content-Signal HTTP Header declaration
findings.description: Declaring Content-Signal in HTTP response headers clarifies AI indexation and training policy.
findings.recommendation: Configure Content-Signal: ai-train=yes, search=yes in edge worker headers.

categories.name: Images & Media
what_works: 100% vector SVG brand logos and navigation icons
Proper aria-hidden and title accessibility attributes on all SVGs
Validated Open Graph social preview images (og-image.png, 1200x630)

findings.title: Web App Manifest and PNG App Icons
findings.description: Currently uses favicon.svg. Adding a site.webmanifest with standard 192px/512px PNG icons enhances mobile browser bookmarking.
findings.recommendation: Create site.webmanifest with standard PNG icons.

phases.name: Phase 1: Quick Wins & Schema Completion
items: Inject BreadcrumbList structured data into the 8 company/legal pages (about, contact, privacy, terms in EN & ES).
Add <link rel="alternate" type="text/plain" href="https://ratecraft.app/llms.txt"> to HTML <head>.

items: Emit security and AI policy headers (X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, Content-Signal) via Cloudflare Worker.
Submit IndexNow bulk ping for any newly touched pages to Bing/Yandex.

items: Add verified financial reviewer credentials to guide articles to reinforce E-E-A-T.
Expand external citations to official tax authority docs (HMRC, CRA, ATO, IRS) on regional calculators.
